correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md precisely defines oriented incidences (j,+), (j,-), pure (not full) strong matching faces and the rotation. Every maximal face has exactly two consecutive absent edges and a single sign switch, giving n(n-1) facets; a nonidentity rotation fixes only sign-monochrome orbit unions, for which the reduced oriented Lefschetz sum is 1+4cos(2πgcd(n,a)/3). The two-state independence transfer T=[[1,-1],[1,0]] has characteristic roots exp(±πi/3). The identity trace and homology-degree concentration use Knudson–Owens–White, Proposition 8.3/Theorem 8.6; rational positive-module constraints yield the stated degree allocation. Special n=6 collision of degrees is handled. Independently constructed all faces and evaluated oriented traces for all rotations for n=6..10 (face counts 162,420,1056,2598,6280); 40 exact comparisons agreed. Finite checks do not establish the all-n statement, which follows from the enumerative proof.
